apps.name: Eclipse
apps.subtitle: Watch, read, and track in one place.
apps.localizedDescription: Discover anime, movies, and shows; organize your library; watch with in-app playback; and read manga and light novels. Eclipse supports user-installed Services, Stremio add-ons, SkyStream packages, Nuvio providers, and Reader extensions. Keep track of progress with AniList, MyAnimeList, Trakt, and Simkl, download media for offline use, and back up your settings and library. Cloud sync is optional and off by default. Eclipse does not include media, content sources, or bundled provider add-ons. Install and configure your own sources to watch or read.
apps.versionDescription:
Eclipse 2.3.0 | Eclipse-unsigned-v2.3.0-20261020-090254

Additions:

-Deep tracker library integration option (AniList, MAL, Trakt)
-Simkl Tracking (Will NOT get deep tracking integration due to free tier limits)
-Ratings and Notes setting
-Concurrent download controls
-Background HLS downloading (iOS 26+ only)
-Subtitle delay
-Dolby Atmos and Dolby Vision support
-epub support (experimental)
-Light novel reader rework

Fixes/Changes (fixes are not guaranteed, different devices behave differently) :

-Fixed mpv backgrounding audio desync, it should take a sec to recover.
-Fixed mpv downstream blowing up
-Changed Alt poster and season building to be more accurate, tested 220 anime, and 100 western shows
-Fixed unaired episode hiding
-Fixed System calendar crash, app now enforces Gregorian calendar
-Fixed Ratings and Notes getting lost
-Removed Performance mode and watch together. No longer needed/wasn't popular. Perf mode is enforced On
-Ratings and notes can now be assigned per season rather than the whole show
-Subtitle edit fixes
-Language filters are now hardcoded values instead of user inputted ones
-Fixed Reader mode library importing not being able to connect a source
-Rearranged settings to push more important ones higher
-Changed some Auto Mode logic
-Fixed audio name detection
-Fixed subtitle name detection
-Double tap to seek no longer brings up the player UI

As always, use GitHub issues or the discord for requests or bug reports.
